title: NuGet package entry without a version
description: packages.config declares a `packages.config` entry that records no version. The restore has no version to resolve, so the project's actual package identity comes from whatever the tooling decides.
remediation: Regenerate the file with a pinned version for every package.
limitation: It matches a `packages.config` entry that records no version in the parsed packages.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
